newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 4.25 bln reais in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 4.25 bln reais in bonds.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 4.25 billion reais in 56-day and 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBCs) at its weekly bond auction Tuesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank sold 2.429 billion reais in 56-day bonds at an overnight rate of 2.324 percent, up from 2.318 percent last week.
The 182-day bonds were sold at 2.214 percent, down from 2.219 percent, totalling 1.821 billion reais.
The financial result of the auction indicated 1.25 billion reais will be added to the banking system as 5.5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
